definitions.basis: Order-creation date in UK time (Europe/London). Cancelled orders #1010, #1014, #1020 excluded. Refunds (#1001, #1006, full refunds same day) are deducted in the window of the order.
definitions.orders: distinct non-cancelled orders containing the product
definitions.order_lines: product lines, excluding VO "Selections" add-on lines
definitions.gross: original line price x quantity, including Easify/VO paid options (Shopify gross sales definition)
definitions.discounts: order-level discount (EAGLE10) allocated to the line
definitions.net: gross - discounts - refunds (excludes shipping and tax)
definitions.asp_index_vs_store_aov: product ASP divided by store AOV (net / orders) for the same window
definitions.share_of_net: product net / store net in window
definitions.landing_sessions: human sessions whose landing page was the product page (ShopifyQL FROM sessions, human_or_bot_session = human)
definitions.landing_cart_sessions: of those landing sessions, sessions with any cart addition (any product)
definitions.landing_completed: of those, sessions that completed checkout (any product)
definitions.orders_per_landing_session: product orders (any landing page) / product landing sessions: an upper-bound proxy, not true conversion
definitions.landing_completion_rate: landing sessions that completed checkout / landing sessions
